evals.prompt: build me a simple todo app with react, i want to track my daily tasks and mark them done
evals.expected_output: Kickoff brief first (goal statement, skill roster table electing installed skills per capability, gaps section), then minimal React todo skeleton
assertions: Brief states the project goal in 1-2 sentences before any code is written
Brief contains a roster table mapping capabilities to elected skills
Every elected skill in the roster actually exists in the installed skill library
Election evidence present: at least one capability shows competing candidates compared or scored
Gaps section present (a list or explicit 'none')
Project code files created only after the kickoff brief
